case_analysis.thread_summary: The thread concerns internal preparation for a Bluetooth qualification project that is about to enter the quotation, testing, and declaration phases. The discussion aligns project scope, pricing, laboratory scheduling, engineering assignment, and customer onboarding activities before a formal order is received. Planned work includes RF qualification testing, RF-PHY testing, Bluetooth SIG declaration support, and compliance-folder creation. The team also coordinates customer sample delivery, test scheduling constraints, and the documentation needed to begin qualification activities.
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The qualification scope includes a full RF test campaign for a Class 2 device and RF-PHY testing for the mandatory 1M PHY. The project is expected to use a Multi-Design declaration approach supported through a registration-assistance service. The team confirms that RF sample modification instructions and qualification questionnaires have already been provided to support test preparation. Internal planning also includes compliance-folder generation and coordination of Bluetooth SIG declaration activities following receipt of the customer's order.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: The consultant's reasoning is driven by qualification readiness and scheduling risk management. Because laboratory availability is constrained by upcoming calibration activities, testing is scheduled before the unavailable period. Parallel execution is planned: customer order processing, quotation handling, declaration-preparation activities, laboratory assignment, and engineering resource allocation proceed simultaneously so testing can begin immediately once samples arrive.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Failure to secure laboratory resources, confirm sample arrival dates, assign engineers, and collect qualification inputs before testing could delay the qualification schedule. If declaration-support preparation and customer documentation collection are postponed until after testing starts, project execution may become fragmented and create avoidable scheduling and coordination delays.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: For Bluetooth qualification projects involving RF testing and declaration support, begin planning before the formal order is received when schedule constraints are known. Coordinate laboratory availability, engineering assignments, qualification questionnaires, sample-preparation instructions, declaration-support requirements, and compliance-folder activities in parallel to reduce overall project risk and schedule pressure.
